products.label: Workload processing estimate
products.use_when: DCP workload cost by workload type, run time/frequency, or a named DCP use case; accept prose or request JSON.
products.required_facts: Workload type and the applicable runtime/run details; calculator defaults are disclosed; workload volume is not a DCP processing input.
products.pricing_basis: DCP rate card; Databricks account prices where present, otherwise explicit REFERENCE_ONLY/PENDING statuses; AWS registry rates by status. No rate substitution.
products.region_scope: DCP registry currently covers US_EAST_1.
products.status_note: Includes CONTINUOUS_STREAMING, EVENT_DRIVEN_BATCH, SCHEDULED_BATCH, ML_TRAINING and BATCH_SCORING. Some compute choices, including GPU jobs and serverless pipelines, can remain PENDING.
products.evidence_ref: Workbook A2-A8, B9-B11, C; Oct 28 Genie benchmark. Partial: selected workloads only; Q13 first-turn area gate failed in the latest full run.

products.label: Classic Jobs cluster cost (configured cluster)
products.use_when: The user explicitly supplies or asks about a configured classic Jobs cluster.
products.required_facts: Cloud, region, tier, driver/worker node types, worker count, Photon choice, run frequency and runtime.
products.pricing_basis: Lakemeter DBU price card (GOVERNED/REFERENCE_ONLY/PENDING) plus cloud VM on-demand list price.
products.region_scope: Regions depend on configured price_regions and loaded reference data.
products.status_note: Function exists; this repository has no product-specific agent benchmark for this path.
products.evidence_ref: sql/02_functions.sql; README.md Notes; validation inventory through 2026-10-29.

products.label: Recommend a job cluster, then estimate its cost
products.use_when: Only when the user explicitly asks to size/recommend a cluster or asks what cluster is needed.
products.required_facts: Workload type, data GB, frequency, optional completion window, cloud/region and node constraints.
products.pricing_basis: AWS Jobs classic/serverless costing; governed DBU price status plus on-demand VM list price. Throughput profiles are ASSUMED until calibrated.
products.region_scope: AWS node families; price regions depend on configured price_regions.
products.status_note: Covers INGESTION, ETL, STREAMING, ML_TRAINING and ML_INFERENCE. Does not automatically replace DCP when DCP facts are missing; sizing profiles are uncalibrated by default.

products.label: AWS S3 storage, requests, and KMS estimate
products.use_when: S3 retained storage, file/request volume, or KMS usage in a DCP estimate.
products.required_facts: Retained TB, files/day, reads and write requests/file, encrypted files/day, KMS keys/requests, storage days; use calculator defaults explicitly.
products.pricing_basis: DCP AWS rate registry: some observed request/KMS rows and a REFERENCE_ONLY S3 storage row; report each line's status/source.
products.region_scope: AWS US_EAST_1 registry.
products.status_note: Do not describe all AWS rates as governed account prices.
products.evidence_ref: Workbook A6, A7, C21; benchmark Q15 and Q20; latest full run 2026-10-28.

products.label: Recurring DCP pay-per-token model API estimate
products.use_when: Recurring model API calls billed per token in a DCP estimate.
products.required_facts: Model, calls/day, input/output tokens per call; confirm other DCP areas.
products.pricing_basis: DCP model-conversion registry plus the runtime DCP rate-card status. The conversion figures are sourced from public pricing; the associated DBU rate is GOVERNED only when an exact current account price is found, otherwise REFERENCE_ONLY or PENDING.
products.region_scope: DCP registry currently covers US_EAST_1.
products.status_note: The conversion records are labeled GOVERNED while their seed rate is REFERENCE_ONLY; setup may replace the rate status from account_prices. Report the runtime line-item status/source and do not infer governance from the conversion label alone.
products.evidence_ref: Workbook A3 and C; benchmark Q16-Q17; latest full run 2026-10-28.

products.label: One-time DCP model job estimate
products.use_when: One-time token workload such as initial model indexing in a DCP estimate.
products.required_facts: Model, total input/output token ranges, and optional API call count; confirm other DCP areas.
products.pricing_basis: DCP model-conversion registry plus the runtime DCP rate-card status. The conversion figures are sourced from public pricing; the associated DBU rate is GOVERNED only when an exact current account price is found, otherwise REFERENCE_ONLY or PENDING.
products.region_scope: DCP registry currently covers US_EAST_1.
products.status_note: The conversion records are labeled GOVERNED while their seed rate is REFERENCE_ONLY; setup may replace the rate status from account_prices. Report the runtime line-item status/source and do not infer governance from the conversion label alone.
products.evidence_ref: Workbook A3 and B11; calculator one-time model job area; latest full run 2026-10-28.
